build_DALLEEncoder: build a DALL-E encoder for feature extraction with configurable hidden dimensions and vocabulary size
build_CAEPretrainViT: build a Vision Transformer backbone for CAE pre-training based on BEiTViT architecture
build_CAE: build a Context Autoencoder model for self-supervised representation learning with momentum teacher network
build_EncoderBlock: build a residual encoder block with ReLU activations and convolutional layers for DALL-E
build_Conv2d: build a custom Conv2d module with float16 support following DALL-E implementation
